questions.q: How does Terraform get installed on your machine?
options: It requires a dedicated Java runtime to be installed first
It comes pre-installed inside every version of the Azure CLI
It can only be built from source code
As a single standalone binary, installable via a package manager like winget, Homebrew, or apt
questions.explain: Terraform ships as one executable with no separate runtime dependency, though package managers make installing and updating it easier.

options: As a standalone binary with no other dependencies
As a component of the Azure CLI, via `az bicep install`
It must be compiled manually from the ARM template schema
Through the same installer as Terraform
questions.explain: Bicep isn't a separate download — it installs as an Azure CLI component, which is why the Azure CLI has to be installed first.

questions.q: What command verifies the Bicep CLI's own version, separate from the Azure CLI's version?
options: terraform version
az bicep version
az login
bicep --check
questions.explain: az bicep version checks Bicep specifically, since it updates on its own release cadence independent of the Azure CLI.

questions.q: Why do both Terraform and Bicep depend on `az login`?
options: Terraform requires az login but Bicep does not
Neither tool actually needs any authentication to create real resources
az login is only needed for the Bicep CLI's own installation step, never afterward
Both tools ultimately deploy into Azure, and authentication against your Azure account goes through the Azure CLI
questions.explain: Whichever tool issues the API calls, both need an authenticated session against your Azure subscription, which az login provides.

questions.q: Why should you run `az account show` before provisioning anything?
options: Because it installs the Bicep CLI as a side effect
Because it is required before installing Terraform
To confirm which Azure subscription is currently active, so you don't provision a resource into the wrong one (e.g. production instead of dev)
Because it permanently deletes unused subscriptions
questions.explain: az account show reports the currently active subscription — a quick check that prevents provisioning into the wrong environment.
